mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recruitment_post ( company_id, author_account_id, source_code, source_program_id, title, body, our_role, wanted_role, wanted_company_count, wanted_region, required_capabilities, closes_on, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{authorAccountId}, #{sourceCode}, #{sourceProgramId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{ourRole}, #{wantedRole}, #{wantedCompanyCount}, #{wantedRegion}, #{requiredCapabilitiesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{closesOn,jdbcType=DATE}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE recruitment_post SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, our_role = #{ourRole}, wanted_role = #{wantedRole}, wanted_company_count = #{wantedCompanyCount}, wanted_region = #{wantedRegion}, required_capabilities = #{requiredCapabilitiesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, closes_on = #{closesOn,jdbcType=DATE}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
